nodes.name: Schedule Trigger - Daily FX Pull
nodes.notes: Fires daily. Current value: 06:00 (instance-local time, honored as UTC only if the n8n instance timezone is set to UTC - verify under Settings > Workflow > Timezone before relying on this). To change the fire time, edit triggerAtHour/triggerAtMinute directly on this node and re-export per README export discipline. If ops ever needs to change the schedule without editor access, switch this field to an expression reading FX_SCHEDULE_HOUR / FX_SCHEDULE_MINUTE from $env instead (see PLAN.md option 2) - not implemented here to avoid over-engineering a single-trigger workflow. Satisfies TASK R2/R3.

nodes.name: Set - Loader Config
nodes.notes: Defines base_currency as a single editable field so it is not hardcoded into the HTTP Request URL/query. Satisfies TASK R1.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Fetch Latest Rates
nodes.notes: Calls freecurrencyapi.com /latest with base_currency from Set - Loader Config. Authenticates via the stored 'freecurrencyapi' n8n credential (Generic Credential Type / Query Auth, param name 'apikey') rather than an $env expression - this n8n Cloud instance denies $env access at runtime (confirmed: 'access to env vars denied'). No literal key value in this JSON either way; only a credential name/id reference, per root CLAUDE.md secrets rule. onError=continueErrorOutput routes transport/HTTP failures to the second output instead of aborting the workflow. Satisfies TASK R1, R4.

nodes.name: IF - Response OK
nodes.notes: Partial-data guard: a 200 response with an empty/missing data object must not be treated as success (a transport-level success is not the same as a valid payload). False branch routes to the error log. Satisfies TASK R4.

nodes.name: Code - Rates To Rows
nodes.notes: Transforms the freecurrencyapi { data: { EUR: 0.92, ... } } object into an array of { base_currency, target_currency, rate, fetched_at } rows matching docs/data-table-schema.md. Code node justified here (built-in Set/Split cannot enumerate an arbitrary object's keys into rows with a computed timestamp). Satisfies TASK R2.

nodes.name: IF - Rows Valid

conditions.leftValue: ={{ Array.isArray($json.rows) && $json.rows.length > 0 && $json.rows.every(r => r.base_currency && r.target_currency && typeof r.rate === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(r.rate) && r.fetched_at) }}

nodes.notes: Explicit partial-data guard on the transformed rows: non-empty array AND every row has all four required fields with a numeric, non-NaN rate. Failing rows never reach the Data Table write. Satisfies TASK R4.

nodes.name: Split Out - Rows To Items
nodes.notes: Turns the single-item rows array into one item per currency pair for the per-row Data Table upsert.

nodes.name: Data Table - Upsert Rate Row
nodes.notes: Upserts into currency_rates keyed on (base_currency, target_currency) using the node's native upsert operation, satisfying the re-runnable/idempotent convention in root CLAUDE.md. Satisfies TASK R3.

nodes.name: NoOp - Log Loader Error
nodes.notes: Single convergence point for all loader failures (HTTP error output, invalid response payload, invalid transformed rows). Isolated from the Data Table write path so failures never corrupt currency_rates, per root CLAUDE.md "Failure must never corrupt stored data". Satisfies TASK R4.
